description: One hour of raw location samples and activity changes recorded by one device.

main.description: One hour of raw location samples and activity changes recorded by one device. The record key is the UTC hour and the device's identifier joined by a colon, such as 2026-10-19T14:6f1c2b0e-8a4d-4f3e-9b21-5c7d8e9f0a1b, so each device writes its own records and a new sample only rewrites the current hour. Visits and journeys aren't stored: every device works them out from these samples.

device.description: Identifier of the device that recorded the samples.

startsAt.description: The start of the UTC hour the samples fall in, such as 2026-10-19T14:00:00.000Z.

samples.description: The location samples, in time order.

transitions.description: Changes in what the person was doing that the device detected, such as starting to walk, in time order.

deletedSampleIds.description: Ids of samples from this hour that the person deleted. A device must not add a sample back once its id is listed here.

deletedTransitionIds.description: Ids of activity changes from this hour that were deleted. A device must not add one back once its id is listed here.

id.description: Identifier of the sample, unique for the account. Corrections and deletions refer to the sample by this value.

altitudeMeters.description: Decimal meters above the WGS84 ellipsoid.

bearingCentidegrees.description: Direction of travel in hundredths of a degree, clockwise from true north.

activity.description: How the person was moving when the sample was taken. vehicle means some vehicle whose kind isn't known; driving, bus and train are specific kinds. Defaults to unknown.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the device was in when it took the sample.

source.description: What made the device take the sample, such as a periodic background check or writing an entry. Defaults to unknown.

mock.description: True when the device reported a simulated location.

transition.description: The moment the device detected that the person started or stopped an activity, such as walking or riding in a vehicle. LogDate uses these to find where visits begin and end.

id.description: Identifier of the activity change, unique for the account.

activity.description: The activity, as the device's activity recognition reported it. onFoot means walking or running without knowing which.

transition.description: Whether the person started (enter) or stopped (exit) the activity.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the device was in at the time.
